plain: Fixed beforehand by fate to happen.

webster.text: Ordained; appointed by previous determination; devoted; fixed unalterably.

example.quote: A permanent council naturally possesses experience, and the members will always be educated with a view to the stations they are destined by their birth to occupy.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina Convention, Colonel JOHN SANDFORD, May 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
